mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over 3 consecutive months signals a shift to accommodative monetary policy, lowering discount rates and increasing the present value of expected equity cash flows, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the federal funds rate above 5.25% triggers a risk-off reaction, reducing equity risk appetite and compressing S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns during tightening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in unemployment benefits claims (PAYEMS) exceeding 1.5% month-over-month for three consecutive months indicates deteriorating labor market conditions, which suppresses equity risk premiums and produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS rises > 1.5% MoM for 3 consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns during labor weakening are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in unemployment benefits claims (PAYEMS) below 1% month-over-month for three consecutive months signals strengthening labor market conditions, which raises equity risk premiums and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS falls < 1% MoM for 3 consecutive months
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns during labor strengthening are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly industrial production index (INDPRO) exceeding 101.5 for three consecutive months indicates robust manufacturing activity, which reduces near-term supply concerns and produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns during supply growth are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in home sales (HOUST) above 460 for three consecutive months signals a strengthening housing market, which boosts consumer wealth and equity risk appetite, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns during housing demand are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in home sales (HOUST) below 450 for three consecutive months signals a weakening housing market, which reduces consumer wealth and equity risk appetite, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST falls < 450 MoM for 3 consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns during housing demand are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 5% for three consecutive months indicates a strengthening labor market, which increases equity risk premiums and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE falls < 5% MoM for 3 consecutive months
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns during labor strengthening are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
